name: Advanced Construction Booster
description: Grants a Bionic Duplicant mastery of infrastructural construction skills.

name: Advanced Medical Booster
description: Grants a Bionic Duplicant the ability to perform all doctoring errands.

name: Allergy Medication
description: Suppresses and prevents allergic reactions.

name: Applied Sciences Booster
description: Grants a Bionic Duplicant a deeply pragmatic approach to scientific research.

name: Astronomy Booster
description: Grants a Bionic Duplicant a keen grasp of science and usage of space-research buildings.

name: Atmo Suit
description: Supplies Duplicants with Oxygen in toxic and low breathability environments.

name: Atomic Power Bank
description:
A self-charging Power Bank made with Enriched Uranium.

It can power buildings via Large Dischargers or Compact Dischargers.

Its low wattage and high Radioactivity make it unsuitable for Bionic Duplicant use.

name: Balm Lily Flower
description:
A medicinal flower that soothes most minor maladies.

It is exceptionally fragrant.

name: Bammoth Patty
description:
A little treat left behind by a very large critter.

It can be crushed to extract Phosphorite and Clay.

name: Basic Rad Pill
description: Increases a Duplicant's natural radiation absorption rate.

name: Biobot
description:
A Pathogen-Fueled Extravehicular Geo-Exploratory Guidebot (model Y), aka "P.E.G.G.Y."

It can be assigned basic building tasks and digging duties in hazardous environments.

name: Blastshot
description:
An explosive projectile designed to defend against meteor showers.

Must be launched by a Meteor Blaster.

name: Brawny Spice
description: Grants +3 Strength when applied at the Spice Grinder.

name: Carved Lumen Quartz
description: A Duplicant has carved this Lumen quartz in a way that really maximizes its Decor value and brightness.

name: Construction Booster
description: Grants a Bionic Duplicant the ability to build fast, and demolish buildings that others cannot.

name: Crop Tending Booster
description: Grants a Bionic Duplicant unparalleled farming and botanical analysis skills.

name: Curative Tablet
description: A simple, easy-to-take remedy for minor germ-based diseases.

name: Custom Parts
description:
Specialized Parts crafted by a professional engineer.

Jerry Rig machine buildings to increase their efficiency.

name: Data Bank
description: Raw Data that can be processed into Data Analysis Research points.

name: Dewdrip
description: A crystallized blob of Brackene from the Dew Dripper.

name: Digging Booster
description: Grants a Bionic Duplicant the skill required to dig hard things.

name: Dream Journal
description:
A hand-scrawled account of Pajama-induced dreams.

Can be analyzed using a Somnium Synthesizer.

name: Dried Berry Pie
description:
A dehydrated Mixed Berry Pie ration. It must be rehydrated in order to be considered Food.

Dry rations have no expiry date.

name: Dried Curried Beans
description:
A dehydrated Curried Beans ration. It must be rehydrated in order to be considered Food.

Dry rations have no expiry date.

name: Dried Frost Burger
description:
A dehydrated Frost Burger ration. It must be rehydrated in order to be considered Food.

Dry rations have no expiry date.

name: Dried Mushroom Quiche
description:
A dehydrated Mushroom Quiche ration. It must be rehydrated in order to be considered Food.

Dry rations have no expiry date.

name: Dried Mushroom Wrap
description:
A dehydrated Mushroom Wrap ration. It must be rehydrated in order to be considered Food.

Dry rations have no expiry date.

name: Dried Pepper Bread
description:
A dehydrated Pepper Bread ration. It must be rehydrated in order to be considered Food.

Dry rations have no expiry date.

name: Dried Spicy Tofu
description:
A dehydrated Spicy Tofu ration. It must be rehydrated in order to be considered Food.

Dry rations have no expiry date.

name: Dried Stuffed Berry
description:
A dehydrated Stuffed Berry ration. It must be rehydrated in order to be considered Food.

Dry rations have no expiry date.

name: Dried Surf'n'Turf
description:
A dehydrated Surf'n'Turf ration. It must be rehydrated in order to be considered Food.

Dry rations have no expiry date.

name: Eco Power Bank
description:
A rechargeable Power Bank.

It can power buildings via Large Dischargers or Compact Dischargers.

Duplicants can produce new Eco Power Banks at the Soldering Station.

Must be kept dry.

name: Egg Shell
description: Can be crushed to produce Lime.

name: Empty Eco Power Bank
description:
A depleted Power Bank.

It must be recharged at a Power Bank Charger before it can be reused.

name: Engineering Booster
description: Grants a Bionic Duplicant the skills requried to tinker and solder to their heart's content.

name: Extreme Digging Booster
description: Grants a Bionic Duplicant the digging skill required to get through anything.

name: Feather Fiber
description: A stalk of raw keratin used in the production of Clothing and textiles.

name: Flydo
description:
A programmable delivery robot.

Picks up Solid objects for delivery to selected destinations.

name: Freshener Spice
description: Slows food spoilage when applied at the Spice Grinder.

name: Gear Balm
description:
Provides a small amount of lubricating Gear Oil.

Can be produced at the Apothecary.

name: Gildgo Molt
description: Can be crushed to produce Gold Amalgam.

name: Grilling Booster
description: Grants a Bionic Duplicant deliciously professional culinary skills.

name: Heat Cube
description: A cube that holds heat.

name: Immuno Booster
description: Significantly reduces the chance of becoming sick.

name: Intermediate Rad Pill
description: Increases a Duplicant's natural radiation absorption rate.

name: Interplanetary Payload
description:
Contains resources packed for interstellar shipping.

Can be launched by a Interplanetary Launcher or unpacked with a Payload Opener.

name: Intracosmic Blastshot
description:
A long-range explosive projectile that defends against distant space objects.

Must be launched by Meteor Blaster.

name: Jet Suit
description:
Supplies Duplicants with Oxygen in toxic and low breathability environments.

Allows Duplicant flight.

name: Lead Suit
description:
Supplies Duplicants with Oxygen in toxic and low breathability environments.

Protects Duplicants from Radiation.

name: Machinist Spice
description: Grants +3 Machinery when applied at the Spice Grinder.

name: Masterworks Art Booster
description: Grants a Bionic Duplicant flawless decorating skills.

name: Medical Pack
description: A doctor-administered cure for moderate ailments.

name: Metal Power Bank
description:
A disposable Power Bank made with Metal Ore.

It can power buildings via Large Dischargers or Compact Dischargers.

Duplicants can produce new Metal Power Banks at the Crafting Station.

Must be kept dry.

name: Microchip
description:
A specialized Microchip created by a professional engineer.

Tunes up Generators to increase their Power output.

Also used in the production of Boosters for Bionic Duplicants.

name: Micronutrient Fertilizer
description:
Specialized Fertilizer mixed by a Duplicant with the Crop Tending Skill.

Increases the Growth Rate of one Plant.

name: Oakshell Molt
description: Can be crushed to produce Wood.

name: Oxygen Mask
description: Supplies Duplicants with Oxygen in toxic and low breathability environments.

name: Pacu Treat
description: A gourmet loaf of ground seeds and Water, formulated to delight Pacus.

name: Pajamas
description:
A soft, fleecy ticket to dreamland.

Helps Duplicants fall asleep by reducing Stamina.

Enables the wearer to dream and produce Dream Journals.

name: Piloting Booster
description: Grants a Bionic Duplicant the expertise required to explore the skies in person.

name: Pinpoki
description:
Pinpoki are aquatic organisms grown in Pinpokets.

They can be processed into Diamond or Uni, or used as Decor.

name: Plant Husk
description:
A bundle of dried plant matter.

It can be eaten by Moos, or processed into fuel or building materials.

name: Plastic Gasket
description:
A flexible Plastic seal, made at the Crafting Station.

Prevents unwanted Liquid leakage.

name: Pokeshell Molt
description: Can be crushed to produce Lime.

name: Power Bank Scrap
description:
A Power Bank that has reached the end of its lifetime.

It can be salvaged for Abyssalite at the Rock Crusher.

name: Primo Garb
description: Increases Decor in a small area effect around the wearer

name: Radbolts
description: High-energy particles used by radbolt buildings and engines.

name: Ranching Booster
description: Grants a Bionic Duplicant the skills required to care for Critters in every way.

name: Reed Fiber
description: A ball of raw cellulose used in the production of Clothing and textiles.

name: Regal Bammoth Crest
description: Can be crushed to produce Gold Amalgam.

name: Remote Worker
description:
A remotely operated work robot.

It performs chores as instructed by a Remote Controller on the same planetoid.

name: Researching Booster
description: Grants a Bionic Duplicant the expertise required to study geysers and other advanced topics.

name: Rocket Debris
description: Whatever is left over from a Rocket Self-Destruct can be recovered once it has crash-landed.

name: Rocketeer Spice
description: Grants +3 Piloting when applied at the Spice Grinder.

name: Rot Pile
description:
An inedible glop of former foodstuff.

Rot Piles break down into Polluted Dirt over time.

name: Rover
description: A curious bot that can remotely explore new Planetoid locations.

name: Rubber Boots
description:
Protects the wearer from Soggy Feet and Slippery floors.

Enables Bionic Duplicants to cross small puddles without Liquid Exposure damage.

name: Rubber Gasket
description:
A flexible Rubber seal, made at the Crafting Station.

Prevents unwanted Liquid leakage.

name: Seakomb Leaf
description:
The leaf of a Seakomb.

It can be processed into Phyto Oil or used as an ingredient in Allergy Medication.

name: Serum Vial
description: A doctor-administered cure for severe ailments.

name: Slogo Molt
description: Can be crushed to produce Lime.

name: Snazzy Suit
description: Increases Decor in a small area effect around the wearer. Can be upgraded to Primo Garb at the Clothing Refashionator

name: Strength Booster
description: Grants a Bionic Duplicant increased carrying capacity and athletic prowess.

name: Suit Training Booster
description: Enables a Bionic Duplicant to maximize durability of equipped Exosuits and maintain their runspeed.

name: Sweepy
description:
An automated sweeping robot.

Sweeps up Solid debris and Liquid spills and stores the material back in its Sweepy Dock.

name: Swim Hack Booster
description:
Overrides a Bionic Duplicant's safety protocols to enable swimming.

WARNING:
Usage stresses bionic systems and does not protect from liquid exposure.

name: Swimwear
description:
Protects the wearer from  Soggy Feet and Sopping Wet effects.

Enables Bionic Duplicants to cross waist-deep pools without Liquid Exposure damage.

name: Table Salt
description:
A seasoning that Duplicants can add to their Food to boost Morale.

Duplicants will automatically use Table Salt while sitting at a Mess Table during mealtime.

Only the finest grains are chosen.

name: Tallow Gear Balm
description:
Provides a small amount of extra-silky lubricating Gear Oil.

Can be produced at the Apothecary.

name: Tidying Booster
description: Grants a Bionic Duplicant the full range of tidying skills, including blasting unwanted meteors out of the sky.

name: Tonic Root
description: A chewy, fibrous rhizome with a fiery aftertaste.

name: Uranium Ore Power Bank
description:
A disposable Power Bank made with Uranium Ore.

It can power buildings via Large Dischargers or Compact Dischargers.

Duplicants can produce new Uranium Ore Power Banks at the Crafting Station.

Must be kept dry.

name: Vacillator Recharge
description: Replenishes one charge to a depleted Neural Vacillator.

name: Vitamin Chews
description: Minorly reduces the chance of becoming sick.

name: Warm Coat
description: Protects the wearer from Cold by increasing insulation

name: Worn Atmo Suit
description:
A worn out Atmo Suit.

Suits can be repaired at an Exosuit Forge.

name: Worn Jet Suit
description:
A worn out Jet Suit.

Suits can be repaired at an Exosuit Forge.

name: Worn Lead Suit
description:
A worn out Lead Suit.

Suits can be repaired at an Exosuit Forge.

name: Worn Oxygen Mask
description:
A worn out Oxygen Mask.

Masks can be repaired at a Crafting Station.
